[LUNI.13.3.1] `rate_num` / `rate_den` carry the **exact** rate. The integrator
converts whatever the rate source reports (such as a decimal string like
`"0.9215"`) into the equivalent integer fraction (`(num=9215, den=10000,
rate_dp=4)`) once on ingestion. No `Float` parse appears in the rate
application path.
